shapeSummary: 20-tooth MOD 0.8 spur pinion (tip dia 17.6 mm, pitch dia 16 mm, trapezoidal approximated teeth, 8 mm long) with a 14 mm dia plain hub (8 mm long), total 16 mm height along Y, bottom at Y=0. 8 mm across-flats hex through-bore along the axis and one radial 3 mm set-screw hole in the hub.
warnings: Gear axis placed along Y (bottom at Y=0) per the rules, although the image analysis listed the axis as Z.
Teeth are simplified trapezoids, not true involute profiles.
Total length 16 mm, hub diameter 14 mm, and the 8/8 split between teeth and hub are estimated from the image.
Set-screw hole diameter (3 mm) and position are assumed; only one is visible, though the product text mentions two.
Hex bore assumed to be 8 mm across flats and through the full length.
cadquery:
N=20
m=0.8
rp=m*N/2
rr=rp-1.25*m
ro=rp+m
p=2*math.pi/N
pts=[]
for i in range(N):
    a=i*p
    for r,d in ((rr,-0.30),(ro,-0.17),(ro,0.17),(rr,0.30)):
        t=a+d*p
        pts.append((r*math.cos(t),r*math.sin(t)))
teeth=cq.Workplane('XY').polyline(pts).close().extrude(8)
hub=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=8).circle(7).extrude(8)
body=teeth.union(hub)
bore=cq.Workplane('XY').polygon(6,8/math.cos(math.pi/6)).extrude(16)
body=body.cut(bore)
screw=cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=0).center(0,12).circle(1.5).extrude(8)
body=body.cut(screw)
part=body.rotate((0,0,0),(1,0,0),-90)
